visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a main character, a young man with dark hair, standing on a large piece of driftwood on a sandy beach. He wears a white button-down shirt and black shorts, spreading his arms wide while facing the ocean. In the background, a large mushroom-shaped coral rock formation known as Flower Vase Rock stands prominently in the turquoise water under a clear blue sky. White subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. (2) A high-angle drone shot follows a red scooter traveling along a scenic winding coastal road with yellow lines. The road is bordered by lush green grass and trees, overlooking the deep blue sea. The lighting is bright and direct. (3) The character jumps off a colorful, painted concrete wall near the shore, wearing a beige vest and white shorts. A white lighthouse tower is shown from a low angle against the sky, followed by a close-up of a mint-green dessert topped with a waffle cone shaped like a tail. (4) The character is seen drinking a creamy beverage through a straw at an outdoor cafe. An aerial view shows a modern building complex with solar panels, outdoor seating, and a large lawn area called Xiao Shan Kan Hai, located right on the rocky coast. (5) In a restaurant setting, the character eats noodles from a spoon. Close-ups feature a steaming bowl of seafood soup with shrimp, clams, and vegetables, as well as a bowl of braised meats topped with chopped green onions. A chef in a black uniform briefly appears behind a counter. (6) The character is now in a transparent kayak on the clear blue ocean, wearing a black life vest and sunglasses, holding a paddle. He looks at the camera while navigating the calm waves. (7) Walking along a stone wall by the sea, the character wears a white hoodie. He sits on a long log on a rocky beach. On the sand, pieces of driftwood are arranged to spell out letters. (8) The video concludes with an aerial shot of the character standing on a small rock in the middle of clear, shallow green water, waving his hand toward the sky while holding a remote control.
